name: Cream Reaper

appearance.body: Concealed entirely beneath a white robe from head to toe, fingers hidden by long sleeves
appearance.face: Black skull mask with stylized design — like a photo-negative of Death
appearance.weapon: Large scythe, various colored tentacles that emerge from sleeves and dimensional portals

personality.demeanor: Speaks in a disturbingly sticky voice. Views his captive women as artwork. Takes pleasure in breaking heroes. Methodical and cruel.

abilities.dimensional_scythes: Can open tears in space from which scythes emerge to attack from any direction
abilities.tentacles: Multiple types — blue fleshy tentacles for implanting 'milk cow seeds', orange thread tentacles for binding, crimson claw tentacles for cutting, all emerging from sleeves
abilities.milk_cow_seed: Can transform women's bodies — massively enlarging breasts, making them produce drug-laced milk, partial mind control
abilities.holographic_projection: Can create holographic duplicates of himself
abilities.underground_facility: Controls a massive underground milk farm with mechanical milking equipment, restraint walls, and environmental projection

background: A supervillain who operates underground milk farms where kidnapped women are brainwashed and physically modified to produce drug-laced breast milk. Previously operated in Bell Valley, USA, where the original Milkman (Roy Snow) destroyed his operation. The Cream Reaper killed the Milkman and relocated to Japan, setting up a new farm beneath Tokyo. He kidnapped over 20 young women before being tracked by both Flare and Dana Snow.

relationships.roy_snow_milkman: Killed the original Milkman and dismembered his body
relationships.dana_snow: Daughter of the man who destroyed his first farm. New target.
